title: Inventory Management API
summary: A RESTful API for tracking stock across multiple warehouses with real-time alerts.
description:
Built for a small retail business that was tracking stock in spreadsheets. The API handles products, warehouses, stock movements and low-stock alerts.

It uses a clean architecture approach with separate domain, application and infrastructure layers, and is fully covered by integration tests.
highlights: 90%+ test coverage with xUnit and Testcontainers

title: Team Task Tracker
summary: A Kanban-style task board built with Blazor, with drag-and-drop and live updates.
description:
A lightweight alternative to heavy project management tools for small teams.

Users can create boards, drag tasks between columns, and see teammates' changes instantly.
highlights: Drag-and-drop columns with optimistic UI updates

title: Payment Reconciliation Worker
summary: A background service that reconciles bank statements against invoices every night.
description:
A .NET Worker Service that imports CSV bank statements, matches transactions to open invoices, and emails a summary report.

It cut a manual two-hour daily task down to a five-minute review.
highlights: Fuzzy matching on references and amounts
Deployed as an Azure Container App on a schedule
